description: Native coder model adapter: AST corpus, GPT2 weights, SCXQ2/XSHARD residency, and KXML execution.

weights.native_rule: Prefer the AST-trained SafeTensors checkpoint in the native coder/trainer. Use serving_gguf only for a llama/Khanary ChatML endpoint after an explicit export and hash record. Do not silently substitute weights.

pipeline.name: select_weight_source
pipeline.note: Use this direction when producing GGUF from GPT2 SafeTensors; tools/gguf_to_safetensors.py is for LLaMA/Gemma-style names and is not the GPT2 reverse converter.

pipeline.name: plan_scxq2_residency
pipeline.output: XSHARD/1 or DDS tile manifest with HOT/WARM/COLD residency

pipeline.name: native_inference
pipeline.native_backend: DirectXMath CPU or configured GPU driver

pipeline.name: commit_jrom_adapter
pipeline.output: JROM metadata and SCXQ2 adapter record

constraints: GGUF is a model container, not an AST compiler.
The coder model proposes AST or one tool command; the host parser, EBNF grammar, and AtomicDOM validate it.
Existing SMGM DDS preview packs must pass full-payload and source-hash verification before production inference.
safetensors_to_model_stb.py currently uses an 8-bit tensor id and requires a format-v2 extension above 256 tensors.
